ry and the Greatness which dwells in them; also concerning this wound
and the plague of the living {14}soul — Jesus is the one who manifests it for{15}
th and proclaims concerning {16}her also, and concerning the rest, manifesting
forth concerning her purification and her healing. Behold, I have made known
to you forth, concerning the manifestation forth of these four fathers, that
each one of them is appointed to his work, in what manner, in a
hidden way and in a revealing forth: ——
